high_level_description: The image features a person standing in front of a backdrop with the words "SUSTAINABLE FASHION WEEK" partially visible. The person is also wearing a large, ornate ring on their left hand, which is adorned with multiple stones or crystals. The backdrop behind the person is green with a circular design element, possibly part of the event's branding.
